title: New Earthquake Theory: Abrupt Electromagnetic Wave Release via Crust Break
content: Earthquake is thought to be due to plate tectonic movement. However, this theory has several fetal defects. First, sudden outset of earthquake in a certain point cannot be due to slow movement of large scale chronic continental drift. Second, plate movement theory cannot explain huge intraplate earthquakes. Third, plate movement cannot explain earthquake light, electromagnetic anomaly, and ionospheric anomalies accompanying earthquakes. Fourth, plate tectonic movement cannot explain the earthquakes on Mars, Venus, or Moon which don’t have plate tectonic structures. Here, I propose that earthquakes are the abrupt release of electromagnetic radiation from the faults or troughs. Light is thought to be weak before the invention of laser. The earth structure is like a laser resonator. High temperature earth core can generate electromagnetic radiation. The emitted light from inner earth can touch the crust and reflect back and forth to enhance huge energy to accumulate for decades until it reaches a crust break to release out. This theory can explain why earthquakes likely happen in crust breaks like faults and toughs. This theory can explain huge intra-plate earthquakes. This mechanism can also explain earthquake light and ionosphere anomaly as well as EM field anomaly. It could lead successful earthquake predictions for the detrimental earthquakes to save people’s lives.
